spans.s: पुत् n. A particular hell to which childless persons are condemned, M.ix.138.
पूत् ind. An imitative word expressive of hard breathing.
पुत्तल m. 1. An idol, a puppet, a doll; 2. a man of straw burnt in place of a lost corpse.
पुत्तली f. 1. An idol, a puppet, a doll; 2. a man of straw burnt in place of a lost corpse.
पुत्तली-दहन n. burning an effigy in place of a lost corpse.

पुत्तलिका f. The same as पुत्तल q.v.
पुत्तिका f. 1. A small kind of bee; 2. the white ant.
पूतिक (I) a. (f. का) Stinking, foul.

पुत्र (II) m. du. A son and a daughter.
पुत्र-अन्नाद m. 1. one who is maintained by his son; 2. a mendicant of a particular order.

पुत्रक m. 1. A little son, a little boy (often used as a term of endearment); 2. a puppet, a doll; 3. a rogue, a cheat; 4. a grasshopper, a locust; 5. a fabulous animal with eight legs (शरभ).
पुत्रका f. 1. A daughter; 2. a puppet, a doll; 3. (at the end of a compound) anything little of its kind, (e.g. असिपुत्रिका, खड्गपुत्रिका).
